scope: Prospective fixed-checkpoint cell intervention on 12 DIV2K validation crops. Not globally unseen images or paired-retrained ablation effect. Conventional bicubic proxy and calibrated ridge diagnostics, no new risk theorem.

data_protocol.checkpoint: epoch1000 no gradient no SR fitting

forecast.hypothesis: Signed alignment 2<d,B(y)-F0> minus ||d||² predicts sign of native-readout gain beyond band/scale and magnitude/spectrum.
forecast.proxy: raw bicubic upsample to128, align_cornersFalse; approximate discrete target, not known box inverse
forecast.normalization: observable cropped bicubic RGB variance Z=max(mean((B-channelmean)^2),1e-8); no test truth normalization
forecast.bands: separate fullRGB and perRGB Chebyshev FFT bands on shaved120: [0,1/8),[1/8,1/4),[1/4,.5001), exclude DC in bands; fullRGB includes DC
forecast.ridge_features: 2 scale indicators+4 band indicators+log1p(change_energy/Z),log1p(F0 variance or band energy/Z),log1p(B variance or band energy/Z),log1p(LR gradient/Z),LR spectrum radial centroid,entropy
forecast.candidate: proxy zero-shot; directional_ridge=same standardized features plus proxyalignment/Z
forecast.ridge_fit: per model, all32 calibration image×2scale×4outcome rows, fixed lambda1, intercept unpenalized; no tuning or test fit

gate.unit: pooled 12images×2scales×3bands per model, correlation disclosed; RGBpolicy separately24rows
gate.class: negative>=12rows spanning>=6imageclusters; recall>=.75; precision>=.6; FPR<=.25; BA exceeds each baseline by>=.05 and each paired image-cluster bootstrap95%lower>0
gate.policy: fullRGB policy uses native iff forecast>0 else zero; paired image-cluster95%lower of MSE reduction>0 versus EACH baseline
gate.combined: classification AND RGB policy; report each of2candidates/model separately, no best-test selection
gate.ties: abs(actualrawgain)<=1e-8 retained counted, excluded sign rates only; forecastzero predicts not harmful for classification but zero-cell for policy
gate.cost: complete preparation/inference/calibration/selection/scoring/IO/runtime, zero SR training; proxy lowres prior may fail

alias_diagnostic.cases: n16 k_low3/5, n32 k_low9/13, each axis0/1 and phase0/pi4 =>16sharedinputs; two square footprints1/64,2/64; same inference scores low/hightruth
alias_diagnostic.construction: k_high=n-k_low, a_high=.25,a_low=.25*k_low/(n-k_low),phase_high=pi-phase_low. One float32 observation shared. Constant .5 is data mean not hard-coded in proxy
alias_diagnostic.proxy: FFT principal |m_i|<=floor((n-1)/2), dropsNyquist; divide sinc(m_y/n)sinc(m_x/n), multiply targettransfer and midpoint phase; observation residual disclosed
alias_diagnostic.freeze: forecasts cannot use true k/axis/phase; samey guarantees identical forecasts; no guaranteed actualflip, retain noflips
alias_diagnostic.evaluation: fresh deterministic counterexample diagnostic; not independent natural generalization or all-estimator impossibility

separation: prepare stores truth separate; predictor never opens test truth/alias_specs. Calibration truth only when fitting. Entire test forecasts/coefficients/prediction SHA freeze before score opens testtruth. All rows retained; numerical failures/incomplete not replaced.
failure_policy: new source version/newroot for changes, never patch frozen formal; guard absolutedeadline+900 cumulative phase; do not extend resume, finite preflight120sec using only0001+onealias, no testtruth reads; preserve all failures
